paragraphs: From Portlaoise test centre, head out along the Abbeyleix Road for just over a kilometre
Take the mini rotary by turning left and continuing straight through onto Abbeyleix Road again
At the next roundabout take the slight left exit staying on Abbeyleix Road
Turn left onto Grattan Street take the next left onto Tea Lane for a short pull-in stop
Move off from Tea Lane and bear right as the road becomes Knockmay Road
Follow it for around 470 metres turn left into Marian Avenue and left again to complete a quiet estate loop
Pull in briefly, then move off and turn left onto Clonminam Road, followed by another left back onto the Abbeyleix Road
At the Abbeyleix Road Roundabout take the slight left exit
Turn right at the Market Square Roundabout and continue into Market Square
Move off again, going straight onto Main Street
Take the 1st left into Church Street and the next left into Jessop Street
At the end of the road turn right onto Coote Street and follow it out toward Rossvale
At the Rossvale roundabout, go straight through and take the left exit into the Rossvale estate for reversing and turnabout practice
Follow the estate roads, carry out a u-turn where directed, and work your way back out
Turn right onto Rossvale, then slight right, and at the roundabout take the left exit onto the Mountmellick Road
Continue on the Mountmellick Road, go straight through the next roundabout
Take the left exit at the Lucy Franks Roundabout onto the N80
Turn right onto Crooked Road for a short stop, then move off and at the end of the road turn right onto Ridge Road
Take the right into Green Mill Lane, and at the end of the road turn left back onto the Mountmellick Road
Head back toward town through the Market Square Roundabout, staying straight
Take the left exit at the next roundabout and slight left at the rotary back onto the Abbeyleix Road
After a short side-road pull-in and sharp right manoeuvre, rejoin the Abbeyleix Road and follow it through the roundabout and rotary back toward Portlaoise
At the Market Square Roundabout turn right left onto Coote Street, left onto Ballyfin Road, and finally left into Oaklawn to finish the route close to the test centre
